data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Yokesh lies in its association with the practice of yoga. Yoga, as a spiritual discipline, is centered around achieving inner peace, harmony, and joy. The name Yokesh, derived from the Sanskrit word for joy, serves as a constant reminder of the ultimate goal of yoga practice – experiencing deep inner happiness and fulfillment.
